one_liner: Mermaid CLI (mmdc) is a local open-source Node/Puppeteer renderer with no hosted API or credentials, so there is no remote API to build a toolkit on. The separate hosted Mermaid.ai API is a different product.
auth_notes: The CLI runs locally and needs no credentials. The GitHub token in building.md is only for the npm registry when building. The hosted Mermaid.ai API (api.mermaid.ai/v1) uses Bearer API keys and OAuth 2.1 for its MCP server, but that is a different product from the CLI.
access_notes: The CLI is free and open source but is installed and run locally, with no hosted HTTP API. Separately, mermaid.ai offers a hosted render API that free accounts can use with a monthly credit allowance. If Composio wants a hosted toolkit, it should target that product instead.
blocker_notes: Mermaid CLI is a local binary that depends on Puppeteer and Chromium, so there is no remote API to authenticate against. The hosted Mermaid.ai API and its official MCP server (mcp.mermaid.ai) are a separate product that could be evaluated on its own. They are not the CLI.

evidence.quote: Implements a minimal Python wrapper over [https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli) for simpler out of the box use.
A local MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that renders Mermaid diagrams and returns PNG images.
This server uses `@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli` internally, which relies on Puppeteer to render diagrams.
The core Mermaid syntax is always free and open-source. Paid plans add AI features, diagram storage, real-time collaboration, integrations, and security controls.
Any Mermaid account works, including a free one, and every account gets a monthly allowance of API credits. Paid plans include a bigger allowance.
